question: what is the average order value of orders with promotions and without promotions on 2024's black friday?
sql: WITH bf_orders AS ( SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, o.CustomerID FROM Sales.Orders o WHERE o.OrderDate = DATE '2024-11-29' ), order_values AS ( SELECT b.OrderID, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice) AS order_value, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Sales.OrderLines ol2 JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = b.CustomerID JOIN Sales.SpecialDeals d ON b.OrderDate BETWEEN d.StartDate AND d.EndDate AND (d.StockItemID IS NULL OR d.StockItemID = ol2.StockItemID) AND (d.CustomerID IS NULL OR d.CustomerID = b.CustomerID) AND (d.BuyingGroupID IS NULL OR d.BuyingGroupID = c.BuyingGroupID) AND (d.CustomerCategoryID IS NULL OR d.CustomerCategoryID = c.CustomerCategoryID) AND (d.StockGroupID IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups sisg WHERE sisg.StockItemID = ol2.StockItemID AND sisg.StockGroupID = d.StockGroupID)) WHERE ol2.OrderID = b.OrderID ) AS has_promotion FROM bf_orders b JOIN Sales.OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderID = b.OrderID GROUP BY b.OrderID, b.OrderDate, b.CustomerID ) SELECT CASE WHEN has_promotion THEN 'With promotion' ELSE 'Without promotion' END AS promotion_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS average_order_value FROM order_values GROUP BY has_promotion ORDER BY has_promotion DESC;

question: which is the single earliest opened account name, select 1 if multiple accounts share the same date
sql: SELECT CustomerName FROM Sales.Customers ORDER BY AccountOpenedDate ASC, CustomerID ASC LIMIT 1;

question: calculate the customer count by state province name
sql: SELECT sp.StateProvinceName, COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS customer_count FROM Sales.Customers c JOIN Application.Cities ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID GROUP BY sp.StateProvinceName ORDER BY customer_count DESC, sp.StateProvinceName;

excluded: error: column "ct.customerid" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function

question: calculate the average completed successfully transaction amount
sql: SELECT AVG(TransactionAmount) AS avg_completed_transaction_amount FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions WHERE IsFinalized = true;

question: calculate the average quantity sold for each stock item
sql: SELECT si.StockItemID, si.StockItemName, AVG(il.Quantity) AS avg_quantity_sold FROM Warehouse.StockItems si JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.StockItemID = si.StockItemID GROUP BY si.StockItemID, si.StockItemName ORDER BY si.StockItemID;

question: What was the total revenue generated in the first quarter of 2013?
sql: SELECT SUM(il.ExtendedPrice) AS total_revenue FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < DATE '2013-04-01';

question: how many customers had backorders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS customers_with_backorders FROM Sales.Orders WHERE BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL;

question: how many customers had backorders? please break that by year, starting from 2000 to 2020?
sql: SELECT y.year, COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerID) AS customers_with_backorders FROM generate_series(2000, 2020) AS y(year) LEFT JOIN Sales.Orders o ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.OrderDate) = y.year AND o.BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY y.year ORDER BY y.year;

question: Identify the top 10 brands by stock count
sql: SELECT si.Brand, SUM(h.QuantityOnHand) AS total_stock FROM Warehouse.StockItems si JOIN Warehouse.StockItemHoldings h ON h.StockItemID = si.StockItemID WHERE si.Brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY si.Brand ORDER BY total_stock DESC LIMIT 10;

question: who is the biggest consumer of 'Northwind' brand?
sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName, SUM(il.Quantity) AS total_quantity FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = i.CustomerID WHERE si.Brand = 'Northwind' GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: list all orders from 01 november 2013?
sql: SELECT * FROM Sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate = DATE '2013-11-01' ORDER BY OrderID;

question: what is the average order value by customer category?
sql: WITH order_totals AS ( SELECT o.OrderID, o.CustomerID, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice) AS order_value FROM Sales.Orders o JOIN Sales.OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.CustomerID ) SELECT cc.CustomerCategoryName, AVG(ot.order_value) AS average_order_value FROM order_totals ot JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = ot.CustomerID JOIN Sales.CustomerCategories cc ON cc.CustomerCategoryID = c.CustomerCategoryID GROUP BY cc.CustomerCategoryName ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;

question: what are the 5 top cities with the highest delay time in delivery?
sql: SELECT c.CityName, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.ConfirmedDeliveryTime - o.ExpectedDeliveryDate::timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delay_days FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.Orders o ON i.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Sales.Customers cu ON i.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID JOIN Application.Cities c ON cu.DeliveryCityID = c.CityID WHERE i.ConfirmedDeliveryTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.CityID, c.CityName ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC LIMIT 5;

question: how many customers bought with discount in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerID) AS customers_with_discount_2024 FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < DATE '2025-01-01' AND i.IsCreditNote = false AND il.UnitPrice < si.UnitPrice;

question: what is the ratio of salesmen to employees?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE IsSalesperson)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE IsEmployee), 0) AS salesperson_to_employee_ratio FROM Application.People;

question: list top 5 suppliers by how many items they sold?
sql: SELECT s.SupplierID, s.SupplierName, SUM(il.Quantity) AS total_items_sold FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID = si.SupplierID GROUP BY s.SupplierID, s.SupplierName ORDER BY total_items_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: count number of vehicles?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT VehicleRegistration) AS vehicle_count FROM Warehouse.VehicleTemperatures;

question: calculate the average unit price of items in the stock grouped by size?
sql: SELECT Size, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Warehouse.StockItems GROUP BY Size ORDER BY Size;

question: count the items in stock which don't have tax rate attached?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS items_without_tax_rate FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE TaxRate IS NULL;

question: top 6 search terms the stock items are being searched by?
sql: SELECT t.tag AS search_term, COUNT(DISTINCT si.StockItemID) AS stock_item_count FROM Warehouse.StockItems si CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(NULLIF(si.Tags, '')::jsonb) AS t(tag) GROUP BY t.tag ORDER BY stock_item_count DESC, t.tag LIMIT 6;

question: top 5 cities with the highest number of suppliers?
sql: SELECT c.CityName, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM Purchasing.Suppliers s JOIN Application.Cities c ON s.DeliveryCityID = c.CityID GROUP BY c.CityID, c.CityName ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, c.CityName LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 ratio of population of a city to the suppliers in it?
sql: SELECT c.CityID, c.CityName, c.LatestRecordedPopulation, COUNT(s.SupplierID) AS supplier_count, c.LatestRecordedPopulation::numeric / COUNT(s.SupplierID) AS population_to_supplier_ratio FROM Application.Cities c JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers s ON s.DeliveryCityID = c.CityID GROUP BY c.CityID, c.CityName, c.LatestRecordedPopulation ORDER BY population_to_supplier_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

question: what was the most successful special deal?
sql: SELECT sd.SpecialDealID, sd.DealDescription, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice) AS total_sales, SUM(il.LineProfit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Sales.SpecialDeals sd JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN sd.StartDate AND sd.EndDate JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = i.CustomerID JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE (sd.CustomerID IS NULL OR sd.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) AND (sd.BuyingGroupID IS NULL OR sd.BuyingGroupID = c.BuyingGroupID) AND (sd.CustomerCategoryID IS NULL OR sd.CustomerCategoryID = c.CustomerCategoryID) AND (sd.StockItemID IS NULL OR sd.StockItemID = il.StockItemID) AND (sd.StockGroupID IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups sisg WHERE sisg.StockItemID = il.StockItemID AND sisg.StockGroupID = sd.StockGroupID)) GROUP BY sd.SpecialDealID, sd.DealDescription ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

question: what day was the highest number of items ordered by customers?
sql: SELECT o.OrderDate, SUM(ol.Quantity) AS total_items FROM Sales.Orders o JOIN Sales.OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY o.OrderDate ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT 1;

question: calc top 3 geographical area that a company targets?
sql: SELECT sp.SalesTerritory, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count FROM Sales.Customers AS c JOIN Application.Cities AS ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces AS sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID GROUP BY sp.SalesTerritory ORDER BY customer_count DESC, sp.SalesTerritory LIMIT 3;

excluded: error: syntax error at or near "by"

question: find the month with the highest sale transactions
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', TransactionDate)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions GROUP BY date_trunc('month', TransactionDate) ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: which customers order more than 130 times?
sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS order_count FROM Sales.Customers c JOIN Sales.Orders o ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName HAVING COUNT(o.OrderID) > 130 ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: calculate the annual supplier purchase totals for 2014?
sql: SELECT s.SupplierID, s.SupplierName, SUM(pol.OrderedOuters * pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter) AS total_purchases_2014 FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol ON pol.PurchaseOrderID = po.PurchaseOrderID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID = po.SupplierID WHERE po.OrderDate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND po.OrderDate < DATE '2015-01-01' GROUP BY s.SupplierID, s.SupplierName ORDER BY total_purchases_2014 DESC;

question: what is the count of orders placed by each buying group?
sql: SELECT bg.BuyingGroupID, bg.BuyingGroupName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS order_count FROM Sales.BuyingGroups bg JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.BuyingGroupID = bg.BuyingGroupID JOIN Sales.Orders o ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID GROUP BY bg.BuyingGroupID, bg.BuyingGroupName ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: list the recorded temperatures in the cold room, including the timestamp and temperature values
sql: SELECT RecordedWhen, Temperature FROM Warehouse.ColdRoomTemperatures ORDER BY RecordedWhen;

question: list the invoices issued in may 2014, including their ids, customer ids, and invoice dates
sql: SELECT InvoiceID, CustomerID, InvoiceDate FROM Sales.Invoices WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATE '2014-05-01' AND InvoiceDate < DATE '2014-06-01' ORDER BY InvoiceDate, InvoiceID;

question: calculate monthly summary of total sales by aggregating the total chiller and dry items sold, grouped by invoice date
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate)::date AS invoice_month, SUM(TotalChillerItems) AS total_chiller_items, SUM(TotalDryItems) AS total_dry_items, SUM(TotalChillerItems + TotalDryItems) AS total_items_sold FROM Sales.Invoices GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY invoice_month;

question: list the order details with customer names?
sql: SELECT o.OrderID, c.CustomerName, o.OrderDate, o.ExpectedDeliveryDate, ol.OrderLineID, ol.StockItemID, ol.Description, ol.Quantity, ol.UnitPrice, ol.TaxRate, ol.PickedQuantity FROM Sales.Orders AS o JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN Sales.OrderLines AS ol ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID ORDER BY o.OrderID, ol.OrderLineID;

question: calculates the total discount amount given for each deal description?
sql: SELECT DealDescription, SUM(DiscountAmount) AS total_discount_amount FROM Sales.SpecialDeals GROUP BY DealDescription;

question: calculates the average transaction amount including tax for each customer?
sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName, AVG(ct.TransactionAmount) AS avg_transaction_amount_including_tax FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions ct JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName ORDER BY c.CustomerID;

question: What are the top 100 customers based on the highest cumulative transaction amounts?
sql: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName, SUM(ct.TransactionAmount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions ct JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName ORDER BY total_transaction_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: list the supplier transactions with supplier names?
sql: SELECT st.*, s.SupplierName FROM Purchasing.SupplierTransactions AS st JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers AS s ON st.SupplierID = s.SupplierID ORDER BY st.SupplierTransactionID;

question: list the order details with stock item names?
sql: SELECT ol.OrderLineID, ol.OrderID, ol.StockItemID, si.StockItemName, ol.Description, ol.PackageTypeID, ol.Quantity, ol.UnitPrice, ol.TaxRate, ol.PickedQuantity, ol.PickingCompletedWhen, ol.LastEditedBy, ol.LastEditedWhen FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol JOIN Warehouse.StockItems AS si ON si.StockItemID = ol.StockItemID ORDER BY ol.OrderID, ol.OrderLineID;

question: list the order details with special deals?
sql: SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, o.CustomerID, c.CustomerName, ol.OrderLineID, ol.StockItemID, ol.Description, ol.Quantity, ol.UnitPrice, ol.TaxRate, sd.SpecialDealID, sd.DealDescription, sd.StartDate, sd.EndDate, sd.DiscountAmount, sd.DiscountPercentage, sd.UnitPrice AS DealUnitPrice FROM Sales.Orders o JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN Sales.OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Sales.SpecialDeals sd ON o.OrderDate BETWEEN sd.StartDate AND sd.EndDate AND ( sd.CustomerID = o.CustomerID OR sd.BuyingGroupID = c.BuyingGroupID OR sd.CustomerCategoryID = c.CustomerCategoryID) AND ( sd.StockItemID = ol.StockItemID OR sd.StockGroupID IN (SELECT sisg.StockGroupID FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups sisg WHERE sisg.StockItemID = ol.StockItemID)) ORDER BY o.OrderID, ol.OrderLineID, sd.SpecialDealID;
